title: Import Codex sessions
commandTitle: Import Codex sessions into the current workspace
description: Find local Codex history, including archived conversations.
importSuccess: The session was imported into the current workspace.
emptyMore: Sessions in this batch are already open in Paseo. Load more to find older history.
empty: No matching sessions. Change the path or archive filter, clear the search, or refresh.
filtered_one: Hidden {{count, number}} session already open in Paseo.
filtered_other: Hidden {{count, number}} sessions already open in Paseo.
excluded: Sessions already open in Paseo are excluded.
restoreHint: Only the selected history is imported.

errors.codex_unavailable: Codex CLI was not found. Install it on the Paseo host and check PATH.
errors.codex_failed: Codex could not read or restore this history. Refresh the list; if it still fails, check the Codex version and history files.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Refresh the list to check the session state before retrying.
errors.invalid_cursor: The history list has changed. Select Refresh to reload the first page.
errors.workspace_unavailable: The current workspace is unavailable. Return to the workspace and reopen the importer.
errors.wrong_directory: Could not prepare the session in the current directory. Refresh and retry.
errors.already_imported: This session is already open in Paseo. Use the existing session or refresh the list.
errors.import_in_progress: This session is being imported. Wait for it to finish.
errors.import_failed: Import did not finish. Refresh and retry; restored or copied history may remain in Codex.
errors.daemon_unavailable: Could not connect to the current Paseo host. Check the connection and retry.
errors.host_mismatch: The import service does not match the current host. Reconnect to the intended host.
errors.configuration_invalid: Codex configuration is unavailable. Check that Codex is enabled in Paseo and its launch command is correct.
errors.plugin_stopped: The plugin has stopped. Reopen the importer.
errors.generic: Could not connect to the import service. Check the host connection and retry.
errors.source_restore_failed: Could not restore the original archive state. Refresh and check the source session before retrying.

crossDirectoryHint: Imports always open here. Same-directory sessions are restored; other directories create a new session with copied history.
copySuccess: History was copied into a new session in the current workspace.
